lines.t: Yo, three years. That’s a thousand days of "not yet."
The sun goes down, but the pain is a permanent set.
I had to take the photos down, I couldn’t look at the frames,
Every smile in the glass was like fueling the flames.
But now the silence is violent, it’s stealing the sound,
I’m digging for your laughter in the frozen-up ground.
The breakfast table’s a desert, a monument of wood,
I’d trade a decade just to hear you laugh—I would.
But the signal is fading, the memory is getting thin,
I’m losing the battle to the "hollow" within.
Lord, I’m a puzzle with a piece torn out,
Just a shell in a desert of doubt!
[Verse 2 - female Rap (Building Speed/Intensity)]
And my heart? It’s a bruise. It’s a deep shade of blue,
‘Cause I know exactly what the world is gonna do to you!
You’re gonna come back home and the light’s gonna be dimmed,
Edges all jagged and your spirit untrimmed.
You won’t be the girl with the sun in her eyes,
You’ll be suffocating under a thousand dark lies!
It kills me to know you’ll have scars just like mine,
New wounds on a soul that was meant to be divine!
[Chorus - Female Vocals (Melodic/Powerful)]
I CANNOT GO BACK! I CANNOT RETURN!
I’ve walked through the fire and I’ve felt the burn!
I am anchored in Love! I am settled in Light!
I’m holding the Father through the dead of the night!
He is my life! He is my all!
I’m staying right here, behind this wall!
[Bridge - female Rap (Passionate/Spiritual Warfare)]
I’m mourning the version of you that walked out that door,
But I’m claiming the version the Lord’s gonna restore!
Standing in the hallway, feeling the theft?
Nah, I’m standing in the hallway ‘til there’s nothing else left!
I know the Mender! The One who heals deep!
The keeper of promises He’s gonna keep!
He mended my spirit! He’ll have to mend yours!
I’M SCREAMING FOR MERCY BEHIND THESE DOORS!
[Final Chorus]
I CANNOT GO BACK! I CANNOT RETURN!
I’ve walked through the fire and I’ve felt the burn!
I CANNOT GO BACK! I CANNOT RETURN!
I’ve walked through the fire and I’ve felt the burn!
[Outro - Female Vocals (Fading/Vulnerable)]
He’ll heal the scars... just like He did mine.
The same Mercy.
The same Peace.
I can’t hear your laugh...
(Female voice, whispered)
But I’m staying.
I’m staying.
